**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| Shipping | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days |

| Specs / In box | Same: over-ear, ANC, 40hr battery, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, case + USB-C + 3.5mm cable | Same |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns** | **30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping** |

**Why A is better:**

Everything else is identical — price, shipping speed, warranty, rating — so the return policy is the decider.

For headphones, where fit, comfort, and noise-cancelling preference matter, that longer, free return window is much lower risk.
